description: Implementation of WebSocket server handling, including handshake acceptance, frame reading, message sending, and error handling within the net namespace.

classes.name: WebSocket
classes.description: Handles WebSocket handshake, message framing, and communication with clients.

methods.name: WebSocket::Accept
methods.description: Performs WebSocket handshake acceptance, validates headers, and initializes encoder.

methods.name: WebSocket::Read
methods.description: Reads and decodes incoming WebSocket frames, handles ping/pong and connection closure.

methods.name: WebSocket::Send
methods.description: Encodes and sends WebSocket frames of specified opcode.

methods.name: WebSocket::Fail
methods.description: Closes the WebSocket connection and logs failure.

methods.name: WebSocket::SendErrorResponse
methods.description: Sends an HTTP 500 error response and closes the connection.
